events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey probe, guard references, live preview status and stale references
events.input: $ wc -l app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs && git log --oneline -4 -- app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs && git status --short app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs cloud/src app/scripts/test-attendee.mjs app/scripts/fill-preview.mjs app/scripts/probe-live-qa.mjs | head; git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -1; git rev-parse --short HEAD origin/main; echo ---; grep -n "heldByPreview\|open_preview\|openPreview" -r cloud/src cloud/admin-ui | head -50; echo ---; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/preview?v=$(date +%s)"; echo ---; g

events.input: $ sed -n 236,262p cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts | cut -c1-260; echo ---; git remote -v | head -4; git branch -r | head -5; git status -sb | head -1; lsof -nP -iTCP:8961 -iTCP:8883 -sTCP:LISTEN | tail -n +2 | cut -c1-80; ls cloud/package.json cloud/wrangler.* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "probe-preview-close\|8961\|vendor-sim" -r app/scripts/run-chain.sh app/package.json cloud/package.json | head

events.input: $ sed -n 46,141p app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs | cut -c1-420 | grep -n "ok(\|^//\|deliver\|output" | cut -c1-400 | sed -n 1,80p

events.text: The probe's day output checks read correctly against the hold code; next I'm starting a local centre and simulator to run it myself.

events.input: $ grep -rln "8961" app/scripts cloud/*.md cloud/scripts 2>/dev/null | head -8; ls app/scripts | grep -i "sim\|local-centre\|start" | head; grep -n "wrangler dev\|SIM_URL\|ADMIN_KEY\|migrations apply\|vendor-sim" app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs app/scripts/run-chain.sh | cut -c1-260 | head -30; grep -n '"scripts"' -A12 cloud/package.json | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find past commands used to start local centre and simulator
events.input: $ grep -o 'wrangler dev[^"\\]\{0,300\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json | sort -u | head -5; grep -o 'vendor-sim[^"\\]\{0,200\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json | sort -u | head -6; grep -o 'migrations apply[^"\\]\{0,200\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json | sort -u | head -3; find . -name "vendor-sim.py" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head -2; ls cloud/.dev.vars >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo devvars-exists; grep -n "SIM_URL\|vars\b" cloud/wrangler.jsonc | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find past start commands for wrangler and simulator
events.input: $ grep -oE 'wrangler dev[^"\\]{0,250}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json | sort -u | head -4; grep -oE 'vendor-sim\.py[^"\\]{0,160}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json | sort -u | head -4; grep -oE 'migrations apply[^"\\]{0,160}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json | sort -u | head -3; sed -n 1,30p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | grep -n "port\|PORT\|usage\|python3\|STATE\|cache" | head -8; grep -rn "persist-to" app/scripts/*.sh cloud/scripts/* 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-260 | head -4

events.input: $ sed -n 10,40p cloud/scripts/probe-funnel-whatsapp.mjs | grep -n "spawn\|wrangler\|--var\|SIM_\|ADMIN" | cut -c1-420; ls cloud/dist cloud/public 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n "assets\|d1_databases" -A3 cloud/wrangler.jsonc | head -14

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start fresh local centre and simulator, then run the preview close probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && S=/tmp/t291v-state && rm -rf $S /tmp/t291v-sim.json /tmp/t291v-*.log && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to $S >/tmp/t291v-mig.log 2>&1; tail -2 /tmp/t291v-mig.log | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply local migrations and rerun the probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to /tmp/t291v-state >/tmp/t291v-mig.log 2>&1; grep -c "✅" /tmp/t291v-mig.log; tail -1 /tmp/t291v-mig.log | cut -c1-160

events.text: The probe passed 29 of 29 on my fresh local centre. Now I'm stopping those servers and checking the push state and the task record against the previous report.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Stop local servers, confirm origin has the probe, and inspect the task record
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && kill $(cat /tmp/t291v-wr.pid) $(cat /tmp/t291v-sim.pid) 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "wrangler dev --port 8971" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "persist-to /tmp/t291v-state" 2>/dev/null; /bin/sleep 1; rm -rf /tmp/t291v-state /tmp/t291v-sim.json /tmp/t291v-*.log /tmp/t291v-*.pid 2>/dev/null; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 2 -w "8971 %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8971/api/me; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 2 -w "8893 %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8893/
